literal: Accumulation hoarding, fame not-desiring men's existence, to the earth a burden.
translation: The very existence of men who hoard accumulated wealth greedily and do not desire good fame is a mere burden to the earth.
modern: செல்வத்தைச் சேர்ப்பதிலேயே குறியாய் இருந்து, புகழை விரும்பாத மனிதர்களின் பிறப்பு, இந்த பூமிக்கு ஒரு பாரமே ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the futility of hoarding wealth without using it for noble deeds. The word 'ஈட்டம்' refers to the accumulation of riches, while 'இவறி' describes the act of hoarding it greedily. Those who hoard in this manner do not seek 'இசை' (fame), which is earned by being generous to others. The poet concludes that the 'தோற்றம்' (existence or birth) of such useless individuals is nothing but a 'பொறை' (heavy burden) to the 'நிலம்' (earth).
